drk.text: Yunnie is born to Lady Pioni and Vervamon, and Tavora smuggles the infant away from Iwset to Shingol to save him from Peemel's rage.
Years later Apepei secretly sends Coernn to track down Yunnie, the inheritor of the Sigil of Iwset, and Maeveen saves him as he is about to jump from Merfolk Vista.

The group joins him and travels to the Urhaalan Valley, where his adopted minotaur tribe is at war with the elves, but Sacumon tricks him into donning the cursed Living Armor and silences him, until Yunnie and Coernn best her in the caves of the Niriso.
Maeveen brings Yunnie to Iwset, which results in the deaths of Peemel and Digody, and Yunnie refuses the throne and smashes the city's sigil, leaving Edara and Apepei to rule, so the war ends.
